params.name: org_id
params.description: Org ID

params.name: lookback
params.description: Lookback period in golang duration format. e.g. '1h'. Either provide from/to or provide lookback/to or just lookback

params.name: from
params.description: From datetime in ISO format 2006-01-02T15:04:05.000Z

params.name: to
params.description: To datetime in ISO format 2006-01-02T15:04:05.000Z

params.name: query
params.description: Edge Delta Common Query Language expression

params.name: limit
params.description: Limits the number of logs in the response. Default is 1000. It can be negative to move the cursor prev direction. Wraps to end if the cursor position is 0. For AI search, limit should be 20.

params.name: scope
params.description: Scope can be audit or log

params.name: cursor
params.description: Cursor provided from previous response, pass it to next request so that we can move the cursor with given limit.

params.name: custom_columns
params.description: Comma separated list of custom columns to include in the recent search queries

params.name: order
params.description: Order of the logs in the response, either 'ASC', 'asc', 'DESC' or 'desc'

params.name: length
params.description: Minimum log length to filter for

params.name: sessionId
params.description: Session ID to track the search session

params.name: pageId
params.description: Page ID to track the pagination state

params.name: save
params.description: The boolean to decide whether to save the query in history

params.name: disable_routing
params.description: Disable routing for the search
